description: This file defines an interface 'EntitlementConsumptionStrategy' within the OrangeHRM leave entitlement namespace, outlining methods for managing leave entitlement consumption strategies including handling leave creation, cancellation, status changes, period changes, and retrieving leave periods and entitlement date limits.

classes.name: EntitlementConsumptionStrategy
classes.description: An interface that defines methods for managing leave entitlement consumption strategies, including handling leave creation, cancellation, status changes, period changes, and retrieving leave periods and entitlement date limits.

methods.name: handleLeaveCreate
methods.description: Initializes handling of leave creation, considering employee number, leave type, leave dates, and entitlement allowance. Returns current and change entitlement details or null.

methods.name: handleLeaveCancel
methods.description: Handles the cancellation of a leave instance and returns the updated entitlement status.

methods.name: handleEntitlementStatusChange
methods.description: Responds to a change in entitlement status, specifics to be implemented.

methods.name: handleLeavePeriodChange
methods.description: Manages updates when a leave period changes, based on old and new start dates.

methods.name: getLeaveWithoutEntitlementDateLimitsForLeaveBalance
methods.description: Retrieves date limits for leave without entitlement consideration in leave balance calculations, based on provided start/end dates, employee, and leave type.

methods.name: getLeavePeriod
methods.description: Returns the leave period for a given date, employee number, and leave type.
